import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def ac_automata_search_precond (haystack : Array UInt8) (patterns : Array (Array UInt8)) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  haystack.size < 1000000 ∧
  patterns.size > 0 ∧
  patterns.size < 1000000 ∧
  (∀ i : Nat, i < patterns.size → 
    let p := patterns.getD i #[]
    p.size < 1000000)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def matchesAtB (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8) (start : Nat) : Bool :=
  decide (start + needle.size ≤ haystack.size) &&
    (List.range needle.size).all (fun i => haystack.getD (start + i) 0 == needle.getD i 0)

def acList (haystack : Array UInt8) (patterns : Array (Array UInt8)) : List (Nat × Nat) :=
  ((List.range patterns.size).flatMap
      (fun pid => (List.range (haystack.size + 1)).map (fun idx => (pid, idx)))).filter
    (fun x => matchesAtB haystack (patterns.getD x.1 #[]) x.2)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def ac_automata_search (haystack : Array UInt8) (patterns : Array (Array UInt8))
    (_ : ac_automata_search_precond haystack patterns) :
    Array (Nat × Nat) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  (acList haystack patterns).toArray
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition auxiliary definitions
def matches_at (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8) (start : Nat) : Prop :=
  start + needle.size ≤ haystack.size ∧
  (∀ i : Nat, i < needle.size → haystack.getD (start + i) 0 = needle.getD i 0)

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def ac_automata_search_postcond (haystack : Array UInt8) (patterns : Array (Array UInt8))
    (result : Array (Nat × Nat)) (_ : ac_automata_search_precond haystack patterns) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  (∀ i : Nat, i < result.size →
      let pair := result.getD i (0, 0)
      let pid := pair.fst
      let idx := pair.snd
      pid < patterns.size ∧
      -- Removed duplicate `pid < patterns.size` check
      matches_at haystack (patterns.getD pid #[]) idx) ∧
  (∀ pid idx : Nat,
      pid < patterns.size →
      matches_at haystack (patterns.getD pid #[]) idx →
      ∃ k : Nat, k < result.size ∧ result.getD k (0, 0) = (pid, idx))
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem matchesAtB_iff (h n : Array UInt8) (s : Nat) :
    matchesAtB h n s = true ↔ matches_at h n s := by
  unfold matchesAtB matches_at
  simp [List.all_eq_true]

theorem mem_acList (haystack : Array UInt8) (patterns : Array (Array UInt8)) (a b : Nat) :
    (a, b) ∈ acList haystack patterns ↔
      (a < patterns.size ∧ b ≤ haystack.size ∧
        matchesAtB haystack (patterns.getD a #[]) b = true) := by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    simp only [acList] at hx
    rw [List.mem_filter] at hx
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hx
    rw [List.mem_flatMap] at h1
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hmem⟩ := h1
    rw [List.mem_map] at hmem
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hEq⟩ := hmem
    rw [List.mem_range] at hp hi
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at hEq
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hEq
    exact ⟨hp, by omega, h2⟩
  · rintro ⟨hp, hb, hm⟩
    simp only [acList]
    rw [List.mem_filter]
    refine ⟨?_, hm⟩
    rw [List.mem_flatMap]
    exact ⟨a, List.mem_range.mpr hp,
      List.mem_map.mpr ⟨b, List.mem_range.mpr (by omega), rfl⟩⟩

theorem acList_spec (haystack : Array UInt8) (patterns : Array (Array UInt8)) :
    ∀ x ∈ acList haystack patterns,
      x.1 < patterns.size ∧ matches_at haystack (patterns.getD x.1 #[]) x.2 := by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := x
  rw [mem_acList] at hx
  exact ⟨hx.1, (matchesAtB_iff _ _ _).mp hx.2.2⟩
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem ac_automata_search_postcond_satisfied (haystack : Array UInt8) (patterns : Array (Array UInt8))
    (h_precond : ac_automata_search_precond haystack patterns) :
    ac_automata_search_postcond haystack patterns
      (ac_automata_search haystack patterns h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  refine ⟨fun i hi => ?_, fun pid idx hp hm => ?_⟩
  · have hi' : i < (acList haystack patterns).length := by
      simpa [ac_automata_search] using hi
    have h1 : (ac_automata_search haystack patterns h_precond).getD i (0, 0)
        = (acList haystack patterns)[i] := by
      simp [ac_automata_search, Array.getD, hi']
    simp only [h1]
    exact acList_spec haystack patterns _ (List.getElem_mem hi')
  · have hb : matchesAtB haystack (patterns.getD pid #[]) idx = true :=
      (matchesAtB_iff _ _ _).mpr hm
    have hle : idx ≤ haystack.size := by
      have := hm.1
      omega
    have hmem : (pid, idx) ∈ acList haystack patterns :=
      (mem_acList haystack patterns pid idx).mpr ⟨hp, hle, hb⟩
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hkeq⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hmem
    refine ⟨k, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [ac_automata_search] using hk
    · have h1 : (ac_automata_search haystack patterns h_precond).getD k (0, 0)
          = (acList haystack patterns)[k] := by
        simp [ac_automata_search, Array.getD, hk]
      rw [h1, hkeq]
  -- !benchmark @end proof

  decide (start + needle.size ≤ haystack.size) &&
    (List.range needle.size).all (fun i => haystack.getD (start + i) 0 == needle.getD i 0)

def acList (haystack : Array UInt8) (patterns : Array (Array UInt8)) : List (Nat × Nat) :=
  ((List.range patterns.size).flatMap
      (fun pid => (List.range (haystack.size + 1)).map (fun idx => (pid, idx)))).filter
    (fun x => matchesAtB haystack (patterns.getD x.1 #[]) x.2)
